references.title: For the ﬁrst time, the 6.85 µ m aliphatic C–H deformation band is resolved into three subfeatures at ∼ 6.83, 6.86, and 6.88 µ m
2025, CAFE: Continuum And Feature Extraction tool
This preprint was prepared with the AAS L A TEX macros v5.2
The intensities of the 3.4 µ m C–H band and of the 4.65 µ m C–D band are correlated, supporting the aliphatic nature of the 4.65 µ m band
